body.heading: Where in the world is Côte d’Ivoire?
paragraphs: Côte d’Ivoire is a country in Western Africa, which is part of Africa.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Côte d’Ivoire is Yamoussoukro. Yamoussoukro is the political capital, famous for its enormous basilica. Abidjan, on the coast, is the biggest city and the business heart of the country.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Côte d’Ivoire is French.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Côte d’Ivoire is the West African CFA franc. The CFA franc is shared with neighbouring countries, so the same money works across the region.

body.heading: How big is Côte d’Ivoire?
paragraphs: Côte d’Ivoire covers about 322,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Somalia.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Yamoussoukro's basilica is one of the largest churches in the world, with a soaring dome and glowing stained glass — and sacred crocodiles live in the lake beside the presidential palace nearby.
Grand-Bassam was the country's first capital. Its leafy old quarter of colonial-era buildings meets a beach where the lagoon rolls into the Atlantic surf.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Côte d’Ivoire on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
